paragraphs.text: Alchemy: New Capenna (alternatively Streets of New Capenna Alchemy ) is a MTG Arena -exclusive card set that was released on June 2, 2022. It is the third set in the Alchemy -series.

Alchemy: New Capenna is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Streets of New Capenna . There are 30 new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . All of the cards are set on New Capenna . The distribution of rarities in Alchemy: New Capenna has changed from previous Alchemy sets with more uncommons and fewer rares. Players can also collect the set for the first time through Alchemy Premier Draft, where a common is replaced with an Alchemy card. Alchemy cards also received a fresh look to make the "A" " foil stamp " for Alchemy at the central bottom of the card visually distinct from the MTG Arena "A" logo. The set features the A22 expansion symbol .
The digital-only mechanics Conjure , Perpetually , Seek and Spellbook are all reused.

paragraphs.text: The Into the Future event associated Alchemy: New Capenna was held on Magic: The Gathering Arena from June 2 to 4, 2022. There were four preconstructed decks intended to highlight how new cards could be used in the Alchemy format.
